opening.argument: The material presents market analysis with defined technical levels and an educational framing, not a deceptive investment offer. The speaker identifies Solana's support area as “between $80.19 and $82.55,” uses Elliott Wave and Fibonacci analysis, and expressly characterizes “the outlook is cautious.” The channel description further states that its content is “for informational and educational purposes only” and “does not constitute financial advice, an offer or solicitation to buy or sell any financial instruments.” Requests to engage, subscribe, and check a membership, along with promotion of an Elliott Wave course, are ordinary channel engagement and paid-content promotion rather than a promise of returns or a solicitation to purchase an instrument.
